description: This bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the popularity scores for five distinct knowledge categories—Llama3, ChatGPT, Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=0 & Gene Ans, and Acc=1 & GT Ans—across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by domain, with the categories ordered left to right as Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis, labeled "Popularity," is scaled linearly from 20 to 220, with tick marks and labels appearing at intervals of 20. Each domain contains five grouped bars, each representing one of the five knowledge categories as defined by the legend. For each domain, the bars are arranged from left to right in the following order: Llama3 (solid blue), ChatGPT (solid red), Acc=0 & GT Ans (hatched with diagonal lines), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (hatched with crosshatch), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (hatched with horizontal lines). The bars are not sorted by height but are presented in a consistent order across all three domains. Visually, the bars are not emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining. Within each domain, the height of the bars varies, with the tallest bar consistently being the red "ChatGPT" bar, reaching approximately 215 on the popularity axis for Basketball. The shortest bars across all domains are the yellow "Acc=1 & GT Ans" bars, which are consistently around 20–30 in height. The blue "Llama3" bars are generally taller than the yellow bars but shorter than the red bars, with values ranging from approximately 30 to 180 across the domains. The "Acc=0 & GT Ans" and "Acc=0 & Gene Ans" bars are generally shorter than the "Llama3" and "ChatGPT" bars, with values typically between 20 and 100. The "Acc=1 & GT Ans" bars are consistently the shortest within each domain.
